verdict: MP stops responding to HTTP client requests. The IIS XPress compression scheme (`suscomp.dll`) left behind by a previously-installed WSUS role is interfering with MECM MP traffic.
fix: Edit `%windir%\system32\inetsrv\config\applicationHost.config` on the MP. Remove the `<scheme name="xpress" ... dll="...\suscomp.dll" ... />` entry under `<httpCompression>`. Run `iisreset`. Clients will reconnect to the MP on their next policy cycle. Long-term: do not install the WSUS server role and the MP role on the same host; if the WSUS role was uninstalled but the compression module remains, this cleanup is the standard procedure.
